description.text: The right fist of Nefarith and the most feared Bonekrusher soldier of the clan. Many Landbreakers had challenged Nefarith's leadership, only to be utterly crushed by Rhodagn's fists.
A super heavy enemy. He uses ventilation pipes to pull in his opponents so that they are close enough to be attacked.
Buffs himself with the power of denstacks. Watch and evade his jets of fire.
